comment: three audit JSONs from PROJECT_ROOT/data/hermes; data/* is gitignored, so a release carries none of
them and the route answered db_lineage [] / workflow_count null as if the matrix were empty. The
snapshot built from it wrote db_tables_count 0 for a host whose lineage names 6 tables. The route now
resolves them through the state root and reports presence per file; the snapshot names its tables and
reports an unreadable or stale source as unknown rather than 0. Listing this schedules nothing.
